text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
There, there, good baby~. Come on now, 
don't cry~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh? What's going on over there?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a sorrowful melodia...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this... With this tone, I shall 
put an end to your tears and elegy.

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: Uwah... hm?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It stopped crying! That's amazing, Earth! 
It's like su-per-po-wers!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To a baby, the violin's tone is an 
adagio... It even has the power to induce 
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... basically, it's super awesome! 
Turbo wants to try too! I wanna make them 
smile with su-per-po-wers!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you are most welcome to. Go ahead 
and play your musica with those fingers.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right! Here goes!
(SCREEEEECH~!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Agyaaaaa~!?

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: Uwah... wahh... WAAAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Awawa, what do I do!? Don't cry, please 
don't cryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's quite all right. I can see how 
kind you're being.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~! How do I make you laugh!? Hey, hey, 
hey, heeeey~!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What do I doooo!?!?

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: ...Kyaha. Kyahaha!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Why? Turbo didn't even do 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brava...! It is quite simple if you listen 
with the ear of your heart!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your voice seems to carry sound waves that 
brighten everything around you. Just 
hearing it puts one in an animato mood!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That is why the baby smiled! Even without 
words, the power in your voice resonated!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooh...? So that means—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo can use su-per-po-wers too...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Your very body is a passionate 
instrument!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, awesome!! Turbo has that kinda 
power! Woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Baby B
text_block_list.text: Wahh, waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? There's another kid crying over there! 
Time for Turbo's su-per-po-wers!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to accompany you! Let us 
fill the park with giocoso through our 
session!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Zoomin' and boomin', Can't stop it! Engine 
at full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Baby B
text_block_list.text: Kyahahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Woow, what's that!? Let us join in too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Gather 'round, gather 'round! Come 
play with Turbo and Earth!!

Passing by the park, I spotted Twin Turbo 
and her friends singing happily. Seeing 
everyone smiling warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll make you laugh even more!! Vroom 
vroooom!!

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: Uwah wah! Kyahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Energico! As gallant as a supercar!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The musica you perform is a melody 
of smiles... The baby's tears seem 
completely banished now.

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Baby
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM!! WOOOOOH!!

Passing by the park, I saw Twin Turbo and 
the baby having a wonderful time. Their 
energetic voices brought a natural smile 
to my face.
